events.body:
## Context

README lists dark mode and `public/index.html` sets Tailwind `darkMode: 'class'` with many `dark:` classes, but nothing ever adds the `dark` class: no toggle, no `prefers-color-scheme`, no saved choice.

## What to do

1. Add an early inline script that applies `dark` from localStorage or `prefers-color-scheme`.
2. Add a labelled toggle (`aria-label`, `aria-pressed`) to the header nav, modelled on `blt-gsoc/js/theme.js`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Toggle switches theme and survives reload
- [ ] OS preference respected on first visit
- [ ] Button is keyboard-reachable and labelled

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-start/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```
